correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the normalization and every case. The group has \(3Q\) elements, \(Q\) linear irreducibles, and two irreducibles of dimension \(d=3^n\) with \(d^2=Q\). The regular representation weights a block nullity by the block dimension. Scalar cubic-root cancellation yields respectively zero, \(2Q/3\), or \(2Q/9\) linear zeros. A noncentral cubic-root matrix has each eigenvalue with multiplicity \(d/3\); an isotropic-independent commuting pair has each joint eigenvalue with multiplicity \(d/9\). Noncommuting blocks are invertible because \((U+W)^3=2I\) and \((I+U+W)(I-U-W+(U+W)^2)=3I\). Counting quotient fibers, affine lines, and isotropic/nonisotropic triangles gives three nonnegative closed forms summing to \(\binom{3Q}{3}\). Direct modular ranks corroborate the exhaustive 2925-support order-27 case and twelve order-243 cases. These finite checks are not infinite or complex-rank certificates.

value.rationale: A natural complete rank-classification problem is solved for arbitrary three-element unweighted convolution kernels on a nonabelian signal group in every positive rank. The theorem proves an exact trichotomy, identifies the geometry of all equality classes, and gives closed counts for every deficiency level. The commuting-versus-noncommuting symplectic distinction produces a qualitative change of nullity. The contribution is structural, not a finite-only table or routine normalization check.
